chapterInfo.content:
20
Mfeɛ apem no
1 # Adi 9.1; 2 Pe 2.4; Yuda 6 Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔfiri soro resiane a ɔkura ebunu no ano safoa ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kɛseɛ bi. 2#Adi 12.9 Na ɔkyeree ɔtweaseɛ, ɔwɔ dada a ɔno ne Ɔbonsam ne Satan no, kyekyeree no mfirinhyia apem, 3#2 Te 2.9-10 na ɔtoo no twenee ebunu no mu, na ɔtoo mu, na ɔsɔɔ ano na wankɔdaadaa amanaman bio kɔsi sɛ mfirinhyia apem no bɛwie duro ansa; nanso ɛno akyiri no, ɛtwa sɛ wɔgyaa no kakra.
4 # Dan 7.9; 7.22; 7.27; Luk 22.30; 1 Ko 6.2 Na mehunuu nhennwa bi, na wɔn a wɔtete soɔ no, wɔde atemmuo maa wɔn. Na mehunuu wɔn a Yesu adanseɛ ne Nyankopɔn asɛm nti wɔtwitwaa wɔn tire no akra, ne wɔn a wɔankoto aboa no anaa ne honi na wɔannye agyiraeɛ no wɔ wɔn moma ne wɔn nsa soɔ no. Na wɔnyaa nkwa bio, na wɔne Kristo dii ahene mfirinhyia apem. 5#1 Ko 15.23; 1 Te 4.16 (Na awufoɔ nkaeɛ no deɛ, wɔannya nkwa bio kɔsii sɛ mfirinhyia apem no twaa mu ansa.) Yei ne owusɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no. 6#Adi 5.10 Nhyira ne kronkron ne deɛ ɔnya kyɛfa ɔsɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no mu. Saa nkurɔfoɔ no so na owuprenu no nni tumi, na mmom wɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne Kristo asɔfoɔ, na wɔne no bɛdi ahene mfirinhyia apem.
Satan ahofadie ne ne sɛeɛ
7Na sɛ mfirinhyia apem no wie duru a, wɔbɛsane Satan afiri n’afiase, 8#Hes 38.2; 38.9; 38.15 na ɔbɛfiri adi akɔdaadaa amanaman a wɔwɔ asase afanan so, Gog ne Magog, akɔboaboa wɔn ano akɔ ɔsa, wɔn na wɔn ano dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea. 9#Hes 38.22; 39.6; Sak 12.9 Na wɔforo kɔgyinaa asase tɛtrɛtɛ no so, na wɔtwaa ahotefoɔ no ne kuro a wɔdɔ no no ho nsraban hyiae. Na egya firi soro guu fam bɛhyee wɔn. 10#Adi 19.20; 14.10-11 Na ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wɔn no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya ne sɔfe tadeɛ no mu, deɛ aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no wɔ, na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ awia ne anadwo daa daa.
Wɔbu awufoɔ atɛn
11 # Mat 25.31-46; 2 Pe 3.7; 3.10; 3.12 Na mehunuu ahennwa fitaa kokuroo ne deɛ ɔte soɔ a asase ne ɔsoro dwane firii n’anim; na wɔannya baabi amma wɔn. 12#Dan 7.10; Adi 3.5; Flp 4.3; Rom 2.6 Na mehunuu awufoɔ, nketewa ne akɛseɛ, sɛ wɔgyinagyina ahennwa no anim; na wɔbuebuee nwoma mu. Na wɔbuee nwoma foforɔ bi a ɛyɛ nkwa nwoma no mu; na wɔnam nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma no mu no so bubuu awufoɔ atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ. 13#Yoh 5.28-29 Na ɛpo yii n’awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no mae, na Owuo ne Asamando yii awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no nso mae, na wɔbuu wɔn mu biara atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ. 14#1 Ko 15.26; 15.55 Na wɔtoo Owuo ne Asamando twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu. Yei ne owuprenu no. 15#Adi 19.20; Mat 25.41 Na obiara a wɔanhu no sɛ wɔatwerɛ ne din wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu.

Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ bi a ɔfiri soro resiane a ɔkura ebunu no ano safoa ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kɛseɛ bi. Na ɔkyeree ɔtweaseɛ, ɔwɔ dada a ɔno ne Ɔbonsam ne Satan no, kyekyeree no mfirinhyia apem, na ɔtoo no twenee ebunu no mu, na ɔtoo mu, na ɔsɔɔ ano na wankɔdaadaa amanaman bio kɔsi sɛ mfirinhyia apem no bɛwie duro ansa; nanso ɛno akyiri no, ɛtwa sɛ wɔgyaa no kakra.
Na mehunuu nhennwa bi, na wɔn a wɔtete soɔ no, wɔde atemmuo maa wɔn. Na mehunuu wɔn a Yesu adanseɛ ne Nyankopɔn asɛm nti wɔtwitwaa wɔn tire no akra, ne wɔn a wɔankoto aboa no anaa ne honi na wɔannye agyiraeɛ no wɔ wɔn moma ne wɔn nsa soɔ no. Na wɔnyaa nkwa bio, na wɔne Kristo dii ahene mfirinhyia apem. (Na awufoɔ nkaeɛ no deɛ, wɔannya nkwa bio kɔsii sɛ mfirinhyia apem no twaa mu ansa.) Yei ne owusɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no. Nhyira ne kronkron ne deɛ ɔnya kyɛfa ɔsɔreɛ a ɛdi kan no mu. Saa nkurɔfoɔ no so na owuprenu no nni tumi, na mmom wɔbɛyɛ Nyankopɔn ne Kristo asɔfoɔ, na wɔne no bɛdi ahene mfirinhyia apem.

Na sɛ mfirinhyia apem no wie duru a, wɔbɛsane Satan afiri n’afiase, na ɔbɛfiri adi akɔdaadaa amanaman a wɔwɔ asase afanan so, Gog ne Magog, akɔboaboa wɔn ano akɔ ɔsa, wɔn na wɔn ano dɔɔso sɛ mpoano anwea. Na wɔforo kɔgyinaa asase tɛtrɛtɛ no so, na wɔtwaa ahotefoɔ no ne kuro a wɔdɔ no no ho nsraban hyiae. Na egya firi soro guu fam bɛhyee wɔn. Na ɔbonsam a ɔdaadaa wɔn no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya ne sɔfe tadeɛ no mu, deɛ aboa no ne odiyifoɔ torofoɔ no wɔ, na wɔbɛyɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ awia ne anadwo daa daa.

Na mehunuu ahennwa fitaa kokuroo ne deɛ ɔte soɔ a asase ne ɔsoro dwane firii n’anim; na wɔannya baabi amma wɔn. Na mehunuu awufoɔ, nketewa ne akɛseɛ, sɛ wɔgyinagyina ahennwa no anim; na wɔbuebuee nwoma mu. Na wɔbuee nwoma foforɔ bi a ɛyɛ nkwa nwoma no mu; na wɔnam nsɛm a wɔatwerɛ no nwoma no mu no so bubuu awufoɔ atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ. Na ɛpo yii n’awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no mae, na Owuo ne Asamando yii awufoɔ a ɛwɔ mu no nso mae, na wɔbuu wɔn mu biara atɛn sɛdeɛ wɔn nnwuma teɛ. Na wɔtoo Owuo ne Asamando twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu. Yei ne owuprenu no. Na obiara a wɔanhu no sɛ wɔatwerɛ ne din wɔ nkwa nwoma no mu no, wɔtoo no twenee ogya tadeɛ no mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
